The published site is static HTML; no visitor input reaches those patterns. No fixed braces release exists yet (every version up to 3.0.3 is affected); approved by James on 2026-10-03 for 30 days.

Build only: http-cache-semantics reaches the docs site through Docusaurus's update-notifier (got, cacheable-request), which only checks the npm registry for a newer Docusaurus while the site builds in CI. The advisory concerns responses cached for several users by a shared cache; that check has one user and the published site is static HTML. No fixed release exists yet (every version up to 4.2.0 is affected); approved by James on 2026-10-03 for 30 days.
